verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-image/right-copy layout with the headline clearly dominant, but the watch strap is cropped at the top and left edges. The price is placed above the subhead (wrong order), the CTA is oversized, and the logo is shrunk to a speck jammed into the bottom-left beside illegibly tiny legal text. B is jumbled: the headline is pushed to the bottom-left and broken into four lines, the warranty fine print is set as large as body copy and becomes the biggest block, the price wraps awkwardly onto three lines next to the CTA, and the logo floats tiny in the middle, so there is no hierarchy or reading order.
